name: ScalperIntel AI
description:
ScalperIntel AI answers questions about ScalperIntel's NinjaTrader 8 indicators and lets verified customers manage their own licenses without leaving the chat.

Without signing in, it answers from ScalperIntel's official product knowledge base: what an indicator detects and plots, what each setting does when you change it, installation and setup on NinjaTrader 8, chart and bar-type compatibility, pricing and license types, and which indicator suits how you trade. Answers are grounded in the knowledge base and cited, never improvised.

After signing in with the email used to purchase, it also works on that customer's own account: list their licenses and status, diagnose a license problem against the real license state rather than a guess, submit a new machine ID, switch between Named User and Machine ID activation, and log an issue for the support team with a reference number.

Scope and safety are enforced in code, not left to instructions. It gives no trading advice, makes no performance or profit claims, and answers only about the software. The customer's email is taken from the verified session and never from text typed into a prompt, so the license tools can only ever act on the account that signed in — naming someone else's email does nothing. Sign-in is a one-time code sent to the purchase email; no password is ever seen or stored.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ScalperIntel AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ScalperIntel AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.scalperintel.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ScalperIntel AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ScalperIntel AI provides these MCP tools: answer, check_license_status, fetch, get_my_licenses, report_issue, reset_license, search, service_status, troubleshoot_license, and update_license.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ScalperIntel AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ScalperIntel AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does ScalperIntel AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ScalperIntel AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ScalperIntel AI is developed by ScalperIntel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
